meta.subject: hardware: fix bug with instruction page fault handling

en.summary: Decode was forcing only a hand-written subset of trap sources onto the integer trap-handling pipeline. Replacing that list with has_trap ensures instruction page faults and executable faults also take the dispatch path reserved for traps.
why_it_counts: The patch changes core decode control logic, not tests or tooling.
The commit message describes a concrete instruction page-fault dispatch failure.
The new condition directly determines whether trapped instructions are routed into the pipeline that can carry trap metadata.
evidence: The only modified DUT file is hardware/core/instruction_decode_stage.sv.
The old pipeline-select condition explicitly listed illegal, alignment, TLB miss, supervisor, syscall, and interrupt cases but omitted ifd_page_fault and ifd_executable_fault.
The same file defines has_trap to include ifd_page_fault and ifd_executable_fault.
The commit message states that piggy-backed page faults were not dispatched and triggered an assertion.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: The bug is an incomplete trap-routing predicate in decode. Some fetch-side faults are represented as trap metadata attached to an otherwise normal instruction slot. Those microarchitectural traps must still be steered into the pipeline path that dispatches trap-causing operations. The broken behavior recognizes only a subset of trap causes, so page-fault-like fetch exceptions can bypass the trap pipeline and reach logic that assumes a normal instruction dispatch.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: An instruction reaches decode carrying a fetch-side page fault or similar piggy-backed trap condition rather than one of the explicitly enumerated older trap causes.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Omit one or more fetch-fault trap causes from the common predicate that forces trapped instructions onto the trap-capable pipeline.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: replace unified trap predicate with incomplete manual list
portability_notes: Apply this where decode or issue selects a special execution path for trap-bearing instructions.
The bug is especially portable to designs where fetch faults are attached to an instruction bundle instead of issued as separate events.
You do not need the exact same trap names; the key is to leave some trap source out of the route-to-trap-path condition.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the decode or issue logic that overrides normal pipeline selection when an instruction carries trap metadata.
Replace the unified trap predicate with a partial list that excludes page-fault-like fetch exceptions.
Keep trap_reason generation intact so the incorrect behavior manifests as misrouting rather than absence of a fault indication.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changes pipeline selection from an explicit OR-list of older trap sources to the unified has_trap signal, which already includes ifd_page_fault and ifd_executable_fault.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In the pipeline-select always_comb block, replace if (has_trap) with the old manual OR-list that excludes ifd_page_fault and ifd_executable_fault.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Instruction page faults or executable faults can be presented to the wrong pipeline, causing failed dispatch, assertions, or incorrect trap handling when the fault should have been taken architecturally.
evidence_for_injection: has_trap is defined in the same file and includes page fault and executable fault inputs.
The removed condition list omitted those two fault sources even though they feed trap_reason generation.
The commit message directly links the omission to non-dispatch and assertion failure.
notes: This is a good cross-DUT injection because many pipelines centralize trap routing in one decode predicate.
If a design uses issue queues instead of direct pipeline selection, inject the same bug at the equivalent route-to-trap issue path.

zh.summary: 译码阶段原先只把手工列出的一部分陷阱源强制送到整数陷阱处理流水线。改为使用 has_trap 后，指令页故障和不可执行故障也会走正确的陷阱分发路径。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是核心译码控制逻辑，而不是测试或工具。
提交信息描述了明确的指令页故障分发失败。
新条件直接决定带陷阱的指令是否会被送入能够携带 trap 元数据的流水线路径。
evidence: 唯一被修改的 DUT 文件是 hardware/core/instruction_decode_stage.sv。
旧的流水线选择条件显式列出了 illegal、alignment、TLB miss、supervisor、syscall、interrupt，但遗漏了 ifd_page_fault 和 ifd_executable_fault。
同一文件中 has_trap 的定义本身包含 ifd_page_fault 和 ifd_executable_fault。
提交信息说明 piggy-backed page fault 没有被分发，并触发了断言。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 该错误属于译码阶段的陷阱路由谓词不完整。有些取指侧故障会作为 trap 元数据附着在一个原本正常的指令槽位上。这类微架构陷阱也必须被送入负责分发陷阱操作的流水线路径。错误实现只识别了部分陷阱原因，因此页故障类的取指异常可能绕过陷阱流水线，进入默认假定“正常指令分发”的逻辑。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 译码阶段基于陷阱的流水线选择
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 一条指令在进入译码时携带取指侧页故障或类似 piggy-backed 陷阱，而该陷阱不属于旧逻辑中显式枚举的类型。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 在强制带陷阱指令进入陷阱处理流水线的公共谓词中，遗漏一个或多个取指故障来源。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 用不完整的手工列表替换统一陷阱谓词
portability_notes: 把该变异应用到 decode 或 issue 中用于为带陷阱指令选择特殊执行路径的位置。
当设计把取指故障附着在指令 bundle 上、而不是作为独立事件发出时，该错误尤其容易迁移。
不需要完全相同的陷阱名字；关键是让某个陷阱来源缺失在“进入陷阱路径”的条件里。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到 decode 或 issue 中，当指令携带 trap 元数据时覆盖正常流水线选择的逻辑。
把统一的 trap 谓词改成一个不完整的列表，排除页故障类取指异常。
保留 trap_reason 生成逻辑不变，使错误表现为错误路由，而不是根本没有故障指示。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: decoded_instr_nxt.pipeline_sel 在 has_trap 周围的选择逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把流水线选择条件从显式 OR 列表改成统一的 has_trap 信号，而 has_trap 已包含 ifd_page_fault 与 ifd_executable_fault。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 pipeline-select 的 always_comb 代码块中，把 if (has_trap) 改回旧的手工 OR 列表，使其排除 ifd_page_fault 和 ifd_executable_fault。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 指令页故障或不可执行故障会被送入错误的流水线，导致分发失败、触发断言，或在架构上应当陷阱时却走了错误的处理路径。
evidence_for_injection: has_trap 在同一文件中的定义包含 page fault 和 executable fault 输入。
被移除的条件列表遗漏了这两个故障来源，尽管它们会参与 trap_reason 生成。
提交信息直接把该遗漏与未分发、断言失败联系起来。
notes: 这是一个优质的跨 DUT 注入点，因为很多流水线都会把陷阱路由集中在一个译码谓词里。
如果设计使用 issue queue 而非直接的 pipeline 选择，应在等价的“送入陷阱 issue 路径”位置注入同类错误。
